content.text: Can I come get a couple quotes on Dave?
I am very happy for Dave. I knew he would be hired quickly and Boston is a good place reuniting with John Henry.
Did you think he'd go to Boston? Off record, just wondering
I had no idea where he was going.
He told me a few days ago he met with two teams at owners meetings. I was thinking Toronto.
I don't know. Got my thoughts on the Tigs
